messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — SI partner raised a couple SOC2 + pen artifacts that are missing from the marketplace bundle. Need a 15-min triage to map gaps and owners. :eyes:

ed: Can you paste the exact gaps? I can take SOC2 evidence if it’s just scoping and logs.

tasha: Short list from the partner (copied):
- missing pen test scope doc with IP ranges
- no presigned S3 bundle for firmware attestation PDFs
- questionnaire CSV missing answers for encryption key mgmt
- sample incident response runbook redactions not present

ben: For the presign flow — are they asking for short-lived presigns for the bundle or a snapshot upload? That changes our S3 policy.

maria: They want presigns for partners to upload redacted artifacts (30m expiry). Link to their gap spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GApartner-gap-matrix (read-only for now).

ed: ok. SOC2 bits: I’ll own the mapping of control evidence -> presigned artifact names. Will need a list of filenames we expect.

tasha: I added an example filename matrix in the sheet under tab "expected_artifacts". Also added who on their side is allowed to upload.

ben: For presign implementation: svc-account needs PutObject permission scoped to key prefix: marketplace/partners/<partner-id>/<bundle-id>/* and presign expiries set to 1800s. Example presign command for infra team:```python
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket':'redwood-marketplace-artifacts','Key':'marketplace/partners/si-123/bundle-202603/firmware-attest.pdf'}, ExpiresIn=1800)
print(url)
```

maria: @ed @tasha assign owners in the sheet and note any redaction needs. Ben can you confirm we can support multipart uploads via presign for files > 100MB?

ben: yes, presigned multipart is supported but we should document the client steps. I’ll drop a short runbook in the sheet comments.

ed: One more: pen test report must be redacted for customer PII before upload. Who owns redaction? @maria ?

maria: I can coordinate redaction on our side for now. Will need the partner to send raw to a secure ingest endpoint (SFTP or presigned upload) and then we scrub and re-upload. Need compliance-bot to create temp ingestion creds.

compliance-bot: created temp creds ticket #INC-8721. Expiry 72h. Link: https://internal.redwood/ingest/INC-8721.

maria: Great. Action items: (1) @ed map SOC controls to expected filenames (sheet) — due EOD tomorrow. (2) @tasha confirm partner upload window and attestation owner — due EOD today. (3) @ben write presign + multipart runbook and add IAM prefix sample — due EOD tomorrow. (4) I will coordinate redaction flow with partner and pull compliance-bot ticket when ready.

tasha: acked. I’ll ping partner now re: upload window and whether they can do SFTP as fallback.

ed: ack. I’ll start filling the expected_artifacts tab.

ben: ack, will add runbook and comment on multipart caveats (client libraries, region-specific signing).

maria: thx team. If anything blocks, we’ll escalate to product-ops. Posting quick note in the marketplace listing tracker after triage. :thumbsup:
